headline: Google Sheets becomes an RPG with Gemini's Build & Canvas
summary: Turn your to-do list into a leveled-up character with AI-powered spreadsheets, but it requires a paid plan and desktop access.
details: Google's Gemini AI can now transform your spreadsheets into interactive RPGs. Using the 'Build' feature in Google Sheets, users can prompt the AI to create complex spreadsheets with formulas, stats, and leveling systems from scratch. This allows for a gamified approach to managing daily tasks and habits.

The 'Canvas' feature then takes these AI-generated spreadsheets and turns them into visually appealing, interactive dashboards. Users can customize the look and feel, adding elements like character levels, progress bars for different stats, and checklists for daily quests, all without writing any code.

The author used this to create a habit tracker, assigning XP values to tasks like 'do push-ups' or 'read 5 pages'. The system tracks progress, levels up the character, and even includes features for adding, editing, or resetting habits, making task management feel like a game.

However, this powerful feature comes with limitations. Both Build and Canvas require a paid Google AI Pro or AI Ultra plan and are only accessible on desktop versions of Google Sheets. This means users cannot access their gamified trackers on mobile devices.

While the lack of mobile support is a deal-breaker for some, the AI-powered spreadsheet RPGs offer a unique alternative to traditional habit-tracking apps. It's especially appealing for those who want to avoid subscription creep and enjoy a more engaging way to manage their daily routines, provided they are tied to their PC.
